name: UNEXSO (Underwater Explorers Society)
brand_truth: The dive society that brought the world underwater at Grand Bahama in 1965, now caring for dolphins in a 9-acre lagoon at Sanctuary Bay.
buyer: Cruise passengers and resort guests on Grand Bahama deciding on a phone; families; returning divers.

design.signature: Dive-gauge history scrollytelling (1965 to today) with archive photos; experience picker with live Peek booking links and published prices

current_site_findings: unexso.com has an SSL certificate error.
Sanctuary Bay pages (UNEXSO's current home) are noindex.
History buried at the bottom of a page.
Diving 'returning soon' with no way to register interest.
pitch_line: Anyone who types unexso.com today gets a security warning, and the Sanctuary Bay pages are hidden from Google; this concept puts your dolphins, prices and Peek booking on one fast page and turns your 1965 legend into a reason to book.
notes: Freeport prospect, high value: SSL failure + noindex. Pitch to Sanctuary Bay management (UNEXSO is part of Sanctuary Bay). Prices exc. VAT as published. Did not use skipTlsVerification on unexso.com.
